elastic-san-base-only.title: Check whether all storage needs to be base capacity
elastic-san-base-only.body: This estimate has no additional capacity, so every TiB is base capacity. Base capacity adds IOPS and throughput but costs more per TiB; if the SAN's total IOPS and MB/s are more than you need, moving some TiB to additional capacity lowers the bill.

citation.source: Plan for an Azure Elastic SAN deployment
citation.quote: Each TiB of base capacity also increases your SAN's IOPS and throughput (MB/s) but costs more than each TiB of additional capacity.

elastic-san-lrs-zone-loss.title: Locally redundant Elastic SAN can be lost in a datacenter disaster
elastic-san-lrs-zone-loss.body: You said this must keep running if one datacenter in the region fails, but this Elastic SAN is locally redundant (LRS). Zone-redundant storage (ZRS) keeps copies in separate availability zones; ZRS capacity costs more and is not offered in every region.

citation.source: Plan for an Azure Elastic SAN deployment
citation.quote: However, if a disaster such as fire or flooding occurs within the data center, all replicas of an Elastic SAN using LRS could be lost or unrecoverable.
